scripts.build: npm run build -w @switchboard/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,gateway,agent,llm -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @switchboard/api" "npm run dev -w @switchboard/web" "npm run dev -w @switchboard/mock-gateway" "npm run dev -w @switchboard/mock-agent" "npm run dev -w @switchboard/llm-agent"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @switchboard/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: bash -c 'docker compose up -d postgres && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && ENABLE_C_FEATURES=false playwright test'
